title: Phone Spectrometer for Public Outreach: Advanced Version with Validation Data
description: Advanced version of the open-source smartphone absorption spectroscopy code used at European Researchers' Night (basic version: 10.5281/zenodo.23400260). Adds sRGB linearization switch, prism and reference-based wavelength calibration, validation scripts, a Python analysis that reproduces all numbers and figures of the companion paper, and all validation data: smartphone photographs (JPG in the main archive; RAW/DNG in validation_photos_DNG.zip; Samsung Galaxy S25 FE) of a DCM dilution series, ethanol blanks, a mixed-dye sample set, laser and shutter-series photographs, and laboratory UV-vis spectra.
